subject: science
concept: Conducting the investigation and rigorously collecting and organizing data
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student conducts their designed investigation, following their own procedure precisely
exercise.pictorial: Student organizes collected data into appropriate tables and charts
exercise.abstract: Student records complete, accurately organized data from their investigation

assessment.mastery_threshold: data is complete, organized, and consistent with the designed procedure
misconception_flags: records incomplete or inconsistently formatted data that would be difficult to analyze

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
